body.en:
Question B-001-013-002.

Why the correct answer is right: Identification is required at the beginning and end of a contact and at least every thirty minutes during it.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "At the beginning of a contact and at least every thirty minutes after that": This omits the explicit end-of-contact identification requirement.
- sourceIndex 2: "At least once during each transmission": A single long transmission could run past the thirty-minute interval, and this wording also misses the required beginning-and-end contact structure.
- sourceIndex 3: "At the beginning and end of each transmission": The contact rule uses contact opening, contact closing, and maximum thirty-minute intervals as the timing structure.
